name: @dashboard-render-sdk-g/sdk-host
description: Private browser host for the first production-shaped native dashboard slice; never publish.

scripts.build: yarn --cwd ../.. tsc6 -b apps/sdk-host/tsconfig.json --pretty false && yarn --cwd ../.. vite build --config apps/sdk-host/vite.config.ts && yarn inspect:bundle
scripts.test:unit: yarn --cwd ../.. vitest run apps/sdk-host/src/queryTransport.test.ts apps/sdk-host/src/transport.test.ts apps/sdk-host/vite.config.test.ts apps/sdk-host/tooling/inspectHostBundle.test.mjs --environment node
